name: GovTech Singapore
summary: Singapore's Government Technology Agency. Candidates report a HackerRank online assessment, live or pair-programming rounds, take-home assignments for some teams, a project deep dive and a system design round.

rounds.name: Online assessment
rounds.what: HackerRank, proctored. Usually about 3 questions, LeetCode easy to medium, with hidden tests that check complexity.

rounds.name: Live / pair programming
rounds.what: Practical Python: a small kata such as a Mars rover, then extensions added live. Clarify, get it working, test, extend.

rounds.name: Project deep dive
rounds.what: One or two projects you owned: decisions, setbacks, stakeholders, user feedback, lessons.

rounds.name: System design
rounds.what: A product-shaped design. For AI product teams expect evals, cost, latency, fallbacks and access control.

tips: Restate the task first. Candidates say OA questions can be framed oddly: pin down the exact rule.
Make rules data, not if-chains. In the rover kata the interviewer adds obstacles and wrap-around next.
Reviewers mention code structure and testability, not only passing tests.
For AI product teams, say how you would measure quality (evals) and what it costs per request.
caveat: Built from public candidate reports. Processes differ by team and change over time; treat this as a likely shape, not an official agenda.
